name: smwsprites-custom-color-bouncing-parakoopa-alternates-height
title: Custom-Color Bouncing Parakoopa, Alternates Height
description:
A parakoopa with a varied jump height; like the green bouncing parakoopa but with their combined height patterns.

Additionaly, this koopa is not colored like any of the original 4, so it's the first fully custom koopa with 100% accurate behavior. Yay.
- Yoshi gets wings when it eats the shell.
- Includes a custom shell-less Koopa, coded by Thomas.
- Includes a sprite that just spawns the shell of the specific color.
- Uses palette F by default.

Requested by Aeon on Summer C3 2017. However, this is fully recoded from scratch unlike the one I uploaded for the event; it also comes with much less bugs. ^u^
